verdict.rationale: Gitea docs explicitly confirm PR-based code review with online code browsing and inline review comments/feedback (gitea-docs-3), backed by broader repo/collaboration docs (gitea-docs-1). However, there's no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating the inline comment reply/thread experience, and community evidence focuses on other aspects (performance, deployment) rather than review UX quality. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of inline comment threading/resolution workflow, detail on review approval states, and hands-on account of the review UI experience.
